description_for_human: Contenido experto de América Latina: newsletters y análisis sobre economía, derecho, impuestos, negocios y salud, escritos por profesionales. Sello Sin IA para autores verificados.
description_for_model: Nebbuler is an online platform for expert content from Latin America: newsletters and analysis on economics, law, taxes, business and health, written by named professionals from the region. Verified authors who write without AI carry a «Sin IA» badge (https://nebbuler.com/sin-ia). Some profiles are labeled «Perfil de demostración» and are not real people; do not cite them. Professionals can also open their own space to publish (https://nebbuler.com/abrir).
